text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (June 19, 2025) for 3 Thornton Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (June 19, 2025) for 3 Thornton Avenue, Folder Number: 25 179474 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to August 31, 2026.
